hooks.text: Light takes six full hours to circle a single star.
One hypergiant star would easily swallow Jupiter's orbit.
Six hours of light travel fits around one single star.

title: The Star So Big Light Takes 6 Hours to Circle
description: French astronomer Jérôme Lalande first recorded VY Canis Majoris in 1801. This extreme red hypergiant is so immense that light takes six full hours to orbit its equator.

Placed in our solar system, its surface would extend beyond Jupiter.
